facts.fact: The South Sudan Revenue Authority Commissioner General directed on 2026-03-13 that all government revenues be paid exclusively through the National e-Tax System, banning manual collection with immediate effect, with electronic receipts as proof of payment.

facts.fact: The government's Integrated Financial Management Information System is linked to the new payment system, and the Ministry of Finance and Planning initiates, authorises and processes government payments, per a joint statement of the Bank of South Sudan and the ministry.
The government's Integrated Financial Management Information System is linked on 24 November 2026 to the RTGS and ACH payment rails, per University of Juba economist Bec George Anyak.
